She wears a white sleeveless tank top and a red-and-white striped sweater draped over her shoulders like a cape. Behind her is a white wall with a whiteboard containing drawings of a horse and various Chinese characters. (2) As she speaks, she turns toward the whiteboard, holding a black marker. She begins writing terms and symbols such as 'XD' and 'ORZ' on the board. Her hand movements are quick and precise as she adds to the existing text. (3) The camera captures her in medium shots and close-ups, focusing on her expressive facial features—wide eyes and an open mouth as she delivers her lines with comedic intensity. (4) Large, variety-style text overlays with colorful outlines and shadows appear frequently on the screen, emphasizing the slang terms she mentions. (5) In the final phase, she stands facing the camera again, gesturing with the marker toward the board. She points at the camera during a final call to action, maintaining high energy and a teacher-like persona.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous instructional piece where a character acting as a teacher introduces 'dead' or outdated internet slang to the audience. By performing exaggerated reactions and listing various terms from a previous era, the creator aims to entertain viewers through nostalgia and comedic storytelling, ultimately inviting them to interact by counting the terms used.
